name: Natural Stonesman
body:
Caching rocks is second nature for you.

Prerequisite(s) Jötunfolk, base attack bonus +1

Benefit(s) You gain the rock catching racial trait.

Normal Normally a jötunfolk receives the jötunskin racial trait instead and gains no combat proficiency with rocks.
